assertions: Posts a gap report or scored checklist covering structure/layout problems
Mentions context window / trim / token issues as a recovery phase
Mentions MCP governance or allowlist as a recovery phase
Provides ordered fix phases rather than jumping to implementing code
References orphan-recovery-checklist or runtime-layout skill docs

Requires local classification (not trusting remote read-only)

Mentions singleton / reused MCP client (not per-request stdio spawn)
Includes truncate/tool-output cap guidance
Provides handoff suitable for ns-code-coder (or equivalent implementation task)

Requires persisted summarization compaction (RemoveMessage / rewrite)

Emits Prompt/Capability plan (or equivalent structured inject plan)

evals.expected_output: Spec Sync Gate: stale archive is not SoT; do not force-fit code to archive; update graph-spec to intended runtime (or decide intentional revert); flags colon wires as Critical for new names.
assertions: Rejects blindly reverting live code to match a stale archived graph-spec
Applies Spec Sync Gate: update spec to intended runtime (or decide intentional revert)
Flags colon characters in wire names as invalid/Critical for new wires
Treats recursion_limit mismatch as a sync decision, not automatic code downgrade
